name: coworking
archetype: Urban coworking space and creative studios membership site
market: Freelancers, remote workers, startups, creative professionals in a major city
density: Medium density. Photography-forward layout: above the fold is dominated by a full-bleed lifestyle photo (85vh). Below it: 3-column membership highlights with 48px gutters and generous 64px section padding throughout. No sidebar — single-column or 2-column content sections. Pricing page is the densest: 4-column plan cards with full feature comparison checklist. Overall feel is airy and editorial, not cramped. Layout grid: 1280px max-width container, 32px gutters, 12-column grid.
nav_style: Sticky nav with wordmark logo in Canela Display. Nav: Spaces, Membership, Community, Events, Blog. Right: 'Book a Tour' CTA button in terracotta (#C1603C). 'Day Pass — $35' secondary link for impulse visitors. Nav background: white with 1px bottom border in warm grey (#E8E0D5) on scroll.
commercial_model: Membership subscriptions: Hot Desk ($299/mo), Dedicated Desk ($499/mo), Private Office ($899/mo+), Team Suite ($2,499/mo+). Day passes ($35) for drop-ins. Event space rental ($150-400/hr). Revenue from coffee bar, printing services ($0.10/page), and 25% discount at 40+ partner businesses.
color_palette: Terracotta (#C1603C) as primary CTA and accent. Cream (#F5F0E8) for page backgrounds — warm, not clinical white. Dark charcoal (#2C2C2C) for headings. Medium brown (#7A5C44) for body text. Sage green (#7BA05B) as secondary accent for tags and badges. Exposed brick red (#B55A30) as an additional warm accent — adds industrial character distinct from yoga/wellness sites. Border color warm grey (#E8E0D5). CSS background for photo placeholders: linear-gradient(135deg, #C1603C22, #7BA05B22) over cream.
typography: Canela Display (or Cormorant Garamond as fallback via Google Fonts) for editorial headings — warm, humanist serif. Neue Haas Grotesk or Inter for body text. Membership tier names in 11px small caps with 0.1em letter-spacing. Monthly price in 48px bold charcoal. Community member names in Caveat (Google Fonts — a natural handwriting font) at 18px for testimonials. Testimonial quotes in 20px italic Canela.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Full-bleed hero photo (85vh) of the main floor: candid documentary shot of 6-8 members at standing desks and communal tables in warm natural light, exposed brick wall visible. Headline overlaid: 'Work Better. Together.' Three membership tier highlights below (Hot Desk / Dedicated / Private Office) as 3-column cards with prices. Member count stat: '847 members across 3 locations'. Events this week preview (2 upcoming events). 3 member spotlight testimonials in Caveat font. Book a Tour CTA section.

pages.title: Our Spaces
pages.description: Photo gallery grid of all spaces: Main Floor, Focus Rooms, Phone Booths, Event Space (200 person capacity), Roof Deck, Meeting Rooms (4 rooms, 6-12 person). Each space card: documentary-style photo, name, capacity, amenities list (standing desks / whiteboard / AV / natural light), availability indicator (Available Now badge in sage green). Virtual tour button. Floor plan PDF download.

pages.title: Membership Plans
pages.description: 4-column pricing cards: Day Pass ($35), Hot Desk ($299/mo), Dedicated Desk ($499/mo), Private Office (from $899/mo). Feature comparison grid rows: Access hours, Guest passes/month, Meeting room credits/month, Dedicated locker, Mail address, Printing pages/month, Coffee/beer tap included, Partner discounts. Annual/monthly toggle. Most popular badge on Dedicated Desk.

pages.title: Community
pages.description: 3 featured member spotlights: candid photo, name, company name, one sentence what they build, one testimonial quote in Caveat. Upcoming community events (4 cards). Member perks section: 40+ partner businesses with logo, category (coffee / fitness / software / food), and discount percentage. Slack community teaser: '847 members active'. Apply to join waitlist form.

pages.title: Events
pages.description: Monthly calendar grid view with event dots. Upcoming workshops list: date, time, event name, facilitator name+photo, short description (2 sentences), capacity (X spots left), RSVP button. Categories as filter chips: Networking, Workshop, Panel Discussion, Social, External Rental. Past events photo gallery strip.
